Ukraine used “flying modems” for the first time to strike the Crimean Bridge, bypassing Starshield restrictions, the Financial Times reports. The system consists of a network of relay drones that maintained a connection between operators and missiles over distances of hundreds of kilometers. This enabled the military to receive real-time video, circumvent Russian air defenses, and precisely guide Flamingo missiles toward vulnerable structural elements of the bridge. The technology was used as an alternative to Starshield, whose operational speeds have recently been restricted again. According to President Zelenskyy, the strike on the bridge was the culmination of a seven-stage operation during which Ukrainian forces spent several weeks weakening Russian defenses.

Local sources and footage from the ground confirmed that Palestinian families are fleeing the northern part of the Nuseirat refugee camp as the Israeli military begins its assault on areas in central Gaza. https://qudsnen.com/share/68627

❗️ The IDF has launched a major military operation on several residential blocks beyond the “Yellow Line”, in the cities of Nuseirat and Al-Bureij in the Central Gaza Strip. A forced evacuation of all residents in these areas is being carried out, and the Salah Al-Din Highway running through the two cities has been closed. At least three Israeli drone strikes have already targeted the area, and heavy gunfire and tank shelling is reported in and around Nuseirat, with Israeli armored vehicles following behind. At least one Palestinian has already been killed in the attacks. Israeli sources claim that the offensive is targeting locations that threaten IDF forces operating behind the Yellow Line. Hamas has condemned the operation, calling it a “blatant violation” of the ceasefire agreement, urging mediators to intervene, but did not indicate they or any of their allied factions will put up any armed resistance on the ground.
